_schema: Per-site reader overrides interpreted by the fixed extractor (data, not code). Each rule: 'match' = hostname or ['host', ...] (bare domain also matches subdomains; leading '*.' allowed); 'include' = CSS selector(s) for the real article container (first visible match wins, bypasses the heuristic); 'strip' = CSS selector(s) whose subtrees are dropped before extraction. include/strip may be a string or an array. Selectors containing a newline or '//' are rejected at load. include/strip are no-ops when their selectors don't match, so an unverified rule cannot regress other pages — only reshape the named host.
_examples_note: Rules validated against live article DOM by the reader-mode agent loop. include selectors are the true article-body container; strip selectors drop in-body ads / related-coverage / bio boxes the generic boilerplate filter misses.
